_comment: Coldstream Gaming Pterodactyl template. Sources: Holdfast dedicated server Steam app 1424230 and CM2Walki/HoldfastNaW.
name: Holdfast: Nations At War
author: admin@coldstreamgaming.com
description: A deployment-ready Holdfast: Nations At War dedicated server. Installs the official Linux server through SteamCMD only when a server is created from this template.
startup: mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64; cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/steamclient.so; cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/steamclient.so; sed -i -e "s#^server_port .*#server_port {{SERVER_PORT}}#" -e "s#^steam_communications_port .*#steam_communications_port {{STEAM_COMMUNICATIONS_PORT}}#" -e "s#^steam_query_port .*#steam_query_port {{QUERY_PORT}}#" -e "s#^server_region .*#server_region {{SERVER_REGION}}#" -e "s#^server_admin_password .*#server_admin_password {{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}#" -e "s#^server_name .*#server_name {{SERVER_NAME}}#" -e "s#^network_broadcast_mode .*#network_broadcast_mode {{BROADCAST_MODE}}#" serverconfig_default.txt; ./Holdfast\ NaW -startserver -batchmode -nographics --serverheadless -screen-width 640 -screen-height 480 -screen-quality Fastest -serverConfigFilePath serverconfig_default.txt -logFile logs_output/outputlog_server.txt -logArchivesDirectory logs_archive/ -p {{SERVER_PORT}} {{ADDITIONAL_ARGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /tmp
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 1424230 validate +quit
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -f linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -f linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so
mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs_output /mnt/server/logs_archive

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the Holdfast server browser.

variables.name: Administrator Password
variables.description: Change this before the first launch. Store it in the community password manager.

variables.name: Steam Communications Port
variables.description: Add this UDP port as a second Pterodactyl allocation before launch.

variables.name: Steam Query Port
variables.description: Add this UDP port as a third Pterodactyl allocation before launch.

variables.name: Server Region
variables.description: Holdfast matchmaking region. Virginia deployments normally use usaeast.

variables.name: Network Broadcast Mode
variables.description: Standard supports large public servers. Competitive uses a higher tick rate with fewer players.

variables.name: Steam Application ID
variables.description: Official Holdfast dedicated server application ID.
